name: Saucy Veracruz Fish Tacos with Tomatoes, Olives, Capers & Jalapeño

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl. Stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice jalapeño peppers into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl with pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and thinly slice garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are soft, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the onions are soft, add olives, tomatoes, and capers to the pot. Stir to combine and bring the sauce to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
3 tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce thickens, pat cod dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg cod fillet
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the sauce is thickened, add fish to the pot and gently stir to combine. Cover and continue to simmer until fish is cooked through, 5-6 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut limes into wedges. Transfer to a plate.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the plate with the lime.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide fish and sauce between plates. Serve with tortillas, avocado, pickled jalapeño, and lime wedges. Enjoy!
